description: The aftermath of Picard's assimilation reshapes the crew as Klingon politics, Cardassian tensions and questions of family dominate a season increasingly concerned with the personal consequences of command.

s04e01.description: Riker commands the Enterprise against the Borg while Data and Crusher search Locutus for a way to turn Picard's assimilation against the Collective.

s04e02.description: Picard returns to his family vineyard after the Borg ordeal, while Worf's adoptive parents visit the Enterprise and Wesley receives a message from his late father.

s04e03.description: Data hijacks the Enterprise after receiving a hidden command from his creator, only to find Lore has answered the same summons.

s04e04.description: A human boy raised by former enemies rejects Starfleet's attempt to return him to his biological family, forcing Picard to reconsider what home actually means.

s04e05.description: Crusher notices friends and colleagues vanishing from reality one by one while everyone else insists they never existed.

s04e06.description: The Enterprise visits Tasha Yar's violent home colony and becomes involved with her estranged sister and rival factions fighting over the settlement.

s04e07.description: K'Ehleyr returns with Worf's son just as a succession crisis threatens the Klingon Empire and forces Worf to choose between justice and political necessity.

s04e08.description: Riker wakes years in the future apparently married and commanding the Enterprise, but inconsistencies suggest his new life has been constructed for a hidden purpose.

s04e09.description: Picard and Wesley crash on a desert moon where a mysterious defense system guards the legacy of a vanished civilization.

s04e10.description: Troi loses her empathic abilities while the Enterprise is trapped by two-dimensional beings pulling the ship toward a dangerous cosmic phenomenon.

s04e11.description: Data records an ordinary day involving a wedding, a possible Romulan defection and the small social mysteries that still resist his analysis.

s04e12.description: A decorated Starfleet captain attacks Cardassian ships without authorization, forcing Picard and O'Brien to confront old wounds from the recent war.

s04e13.description: A woman appears to fulfill an ancient contract claiming ownership of an entire planet, and Picard tests whether supernatural power can survive careful investigation.

s04e14.description: The crew discovers that a brief period of unconsciousness lasted far longer than Data reports, and Picard becomes convinced the android is hiding something under direct orders.

s04e15.description: Riker is injured while secretly observing a civilization approaching warp capability, exposing the Federation's presence before its leaders are ready for it.

s04e16.description: The Enterprise encounters the offspring of a spaceborne creature it accidentally killed, while Geordi's real-life meeting with Leah Brahms collides with his holodeck idealization of her.

s04e17.description: The Enterprise finds a missing starship whose crew descended into madness, then begins suffering the same sleepless hallucinations while trapped in an anomalous region.

s04e18.description: Geordi investigates the disappearance of former away-team members and discovers that an encounter years earlier is transforming them into another species.

s04e19.description: An alien probe vastly increases Barclay's intelligence until he integrates himself with the Enterprise computer and takes the ship somewhere no one expected.

s04e20.description: Q repays Picard for past help by casting him and his senior officers into a Robin Hood fantasy while Vash's future hangs in the balance.

s04e21.description: An investigation into sabotage mutates into a paranoid witch hunt, forcing Picard to oppose a celebrated admiral who sees conspiracy everywhere.

s04e22.description: Lwaxana falls for a scientist whose culture requires him to die at sixty, turning her usual exuberance into a confrontation with ritualized suicide.

s04e23.description: Crusher falls in love with a Trill ambassador and discovers that the person she knows is a symbiont whose identity survives through different hosts.

s04e24.description: Romulans abduct and condition Geordi to assassinate a Klingon official, while the Enterprise tries to uncover a conspiracy hidden inside his altered memories.

s04e25.description: Data attempts a romantic relationship with a crewmate by applying logic to intimacy, just as strange spatial distortions begin cutting through the ship.

s04e26.description: Worf leaves Starfleet to restore his family's honor as rival claimants push the Klingon Empire toward civil war and Romulan interference looms behind the conflict.
